summary: Tested the Invita un'Amica referral feature, share tracking and the owner room stats. Backend: 12/12 pytest pass. HTTP tests used the owner session. Reward logic was tested by importing server.py and calling the functions directly with temporary test_ref_* users. Results: GET /referral/me returns the same 7-char code each time plus counts, is_top and top_at=3. Claim works for a new user (creates a 'joined' referral and sets referred_by). Errors are correct: self 400, invalid code 404, user older than 14 days or with try-ons 409, second claim {already:true}, too-short code 422. First try-on qualifies the referral exactly once: invitee +5 credits; FREE inviter +5 credits; SINGLE inviter +7 days and no credits. _referral_on_payment runs once only: FREE inviter gets SINGLE for 30 days, FAMILY inviter gets +30 days. is_top turns true at the 3rd qualified friend. daily_shares has 30 days and excludes owner events. Code review: _apply_paid_session calls _referral_on_payment for single/family and not for extra. Frontend (Playwright, owner session): opening /?ref=CODE stores atelier_ref; after login ReferralClaimer posts the claim and removes the key. The invite card shows the correct link, Copy works (clipboard + toast), Invia opens WhatsApp, the stats show 3/3/1 and the Atelierista TOP badge shows with 3 qualified (seeded, then removed). The ShareLook buttons whatsapp/facebook/telegram/instagram each POST /api/share-events; Instagram downloads the photo. /stanza shows LOOK CONDIVISI E INVITI with the KPIs and the 30-day chart. All test data cleaned up.

minor.issue: No rate limit or channel whitelist: any user can inflate the owner-room share stats with arbitrary channel strings.
Not filtered by livemode: a Stripe TEST payment by an invited friend gives the inviter +30 days. The owner stats only count livemode payments, so the two are inconsistent.

integration_issues.issue: POST /api/referral/claim fires twice per login (effect re-runs on the user change or StrictMode). Harmless because the endpoint is idempotent. The key is also removed on any error (403 prelaunch, network), so before launch a non-owner friend loses the ref code.

issues: Backend returns referrals.qualified but there is no KPI for it (only invited and paid are shown)

action_items: Optional: whitelist share-events channels (whatsapp/facebook/telegram/instagram/native) and add a simple per-user daily cap
Optional: skip the referral payment reward when the transaction is not livemode, to match the owner stats
Optional: show the 'qualified' referral KPI on /stanza
Optional: ShareLook share text uses the fixed https://myatelierapp.it; using the user's personal ?ref= link would make shares count as referrals
critical_code_review_comments: Reward logic is atomic (find_one_and_update with status/paid_at guard) and there is a unique index on referrals.invitee_id: no double rewards found
server.py is 3178 lines; it should be split into modules
seed_data_creation: Temporary test_ref_* users, referrals and share events, plus 3 fake qualified referrals for the owner, all deleted after the tests. The owner's referral_code D710E13 remains (generated by the app).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Prelaunch gate: non-owner users get 403 on all API endpoints, so test the claim/reward logic by importing server.py, using a fresh AsyncIOMotorClient assigned to server.db (see test_referral_share.py run()). Owner session token: pending_test_tok.
